remarks: Turnkey 2/3-Bedroom Condo in the Heart of New Canaan  Move right into this spacious and freshly painted condo, ideally located just a short walk from New Canaan's charming town center, shopping, dining, and top amenities. This immaculate and flexible floor plan offers two spacious en-suite bedrooms and a third bedroom or optional family room, conveniently located near a full hall bath-perfect for guests or a home office setup.  The open-concept living and dining area is filled with natural light and opens onto a private, secluded patio, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen features high-end appliances and quality finishes, perfect for cooking enthusiasts. Enjoy the ease of condo living with added perks, including access to a community pool-all in a well-maintained complex in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after locations.
